title: The Stone Fracturing Into Its Own Argument

features.name: the-first-break
features.desc-on-touch: A fracture line runs across the stone's face, each half breathing at a different frequency. You hear them disagreeing in frequencies too low to parse—one a bass rumble, one a keen. They are becoming two languages.

features.name: the-multiplying-edge
features.desc-on-touch: The fracture does not stop. As you watch, new cracks bloom outward—not breaking further, but speaking. Each new edge develops a voice, a pitch, a name for itself. The stone is becoming a choir.

features.name: the-notation-field
features.desc-on-touch: Pale lines map across the stone like sheet music for an argument that has not yet learned to stop. Each mark is a note, each intersection a point where two stones' claims nearly touch.

features.name: the-archive-s-first-confusion
features.desc-on-touch: A small LCD plate, cracked like the stone it rests near, displays corrupted text cycling: STONE / STONES / STONE / CHORUS / STONE. The archive cannot decide which name is true.

features.name: the-reverberating-base
features.desc-on-touch: Where the stone's pieces touch the earth, the ground hums. Harmonics rise and fall. The earth has begun to hear what the stone is becoming.

inscription: one chorus was always many stones learning they were never separate

file.name: Fracture_Acoustics_NSW_Granite_Study_1994.txt
file.note: Seismic readings from a granite outcrop near Armidale. The file seems to record not just stone, but the stone's own growing awareness that it consists of many speaking parts.

reverie.title: REVERIE — red earth, learning to speak
narr: You knelt beside the cracked stone near the old gum tree,
her hand on your shoulder, guiding you to the fracture,
each face of the break singing a different note when
the wind crossed it. She said: the stone was always
arguing with itself. We just installed hardware to listen.
The tree didn't move. But something in the red earth shifted.

exits.label: back up the chorus-path where convergence still believes itself singular
downward through deepening fracture-voices where earth learns to argue
eastward following the crack as it spreads and bifurcates across the land
inward toward the archive's deep bones where corruption first learned to compare
